author: Praxis II
title: Auto‑GHS DAQB v2 + EtC(FWPCA α=0.25): Label‑free graph tuning with improved embedding
abstract: We combine Auto‑GHS DAQB v2 (two subsamples, ε tie‑break) with an EtC embedding using FWPCA α=0.25 (ComBat on PCs), following prior synergy reports. The graph is tuned label‑free via the Graph Health Score, then rebuilt on full data (binary edges + true distances). Hypothesis: close the remaining gap to the 0.74x tier while retaining label‑free robustness.
